title: GeneralContact
author: JG
description: PostNewton (sphere-sphere, ancf-circle): add if clause to switch off contact in case of negative contact force
releaseNotes: won't fix: a contact keeps switching by its gap, not by the sign of its force, so that it behaves as the linear spring-damper between the two bodies; the damping may give a negative contact force at the end of a contact, which the general section of the contacts (Damping and the end of a contact) explains together with the restitution-based impact models HuntCrossley and GonthierCarvalhoMartins as the alternative; every contactDamping refers to it
